5\. A missing pull request hides its review 🐞 Bug ≡ Correctness 
The no-open-PR branch of the review protocol writes a blocker file but, under pull_request,
explicitly commits it nowhere even if the mission branch exists. When that blocker stops the
pipeline, the architect is instructed to read the review from the mission branch, where the file is
absent.
Agent Prompt ``` ## Issue description A no-pull-request blocker review is not committed even when its mission branch exists, leaving the architect's documented read path empty. ## Fix Focus Areas - templates/REVIEW-PROTOCOL.md[61-65] - meta/REVIEW-PROTOCOL.md[61-65] ## Recommended Fix Check whether the named mission branch exists and commit the blocker review there when it does, as the unreadable-rules path already directs. Specify a usable handoff when no branch exists. ``` ⓘ Copy this prompt and use it to remediate the issue with your preferred AI generation tools
